name: Yale OpenHand (Model T / T42 / O)
summary: Aaron Dollar's lab's library of low-cost, 3D-printed underactuated hands, whose fingers conform mechanically to an object so few motors are needed. Model T drives four fingers from one actuator through a pulley differential; T42 has two independently driven flexure fingers for in-hand manipulation; Model O, derived from the iHY / RightHand Robotics Reflex, has three fingers plus an abduction actuator. CAD and build guides are public.
